title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of… (CVE-2026-80484)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a vulnerability due to the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. This flaw allows a low privileged local attacker to potentially expose sensitive information. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
